evaluation_dataset: Clinical (60 images, Almaty medical centre, Topcon-class camera)
cross_validation: 5-fold patient-level stratified on IDRiD, Clinical held out as test
notes: Read the PAIRED confidence intervals. At n = 60 the per-arm unpaired bootstrap intervals overlap (C [0.4402, 0.5898], D [0.5238, 0.6642]); significance comes from the paired test, where both arms are scored on the very same 60 images.
The pipeline is ahead on the internal IDRiD CV in all five folds (smallest margin 0.0581).

The clinical gain here (+7.90pp) is comparable to the full-EyePACS gain (+6.55pp), so the pipeline advantage is NOT specific to the small-data regime and does not wash out as data grows. The earlier framing 'preprocessing matters most when data is scarce' is superseded.
Absolute F1 of 0.52-0.59 is expected for training on 516 images and testing in a different clinic; the informative quantity is the difference between arms.
